name: Wet and Soft
source:
Ellie is a clumsy, air-headed, single and young girl who has a fishy companion on her backyard pool. After a long and hard day Ellie might find out that the best company it's where she least expected.  

[From [url=https://wetandsoft.itch.io/wetandsoft]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾莉是个笨手笨脚、有些迷糊的年轻单身女孩，后院的泳池里住着一位鱼一般的伙伴。漫长而辛苦的一天过后，艾莉或许会发现，最好的陪伴就藏在她最意想不到的地方。

[摘自[url=https://wetandsoft.itch.io/wetandsoft]Itch.io[/url]]
